title: Mexican Army Captures CJNG Senior Lieutenant 'The Gardener' in Post-Mencho Security Offensive
detail: The Mexican Army captured Audias Flores Silva, known as 'El Jardinero' ('The Gardener'), a senior CJNG lieutenant and close ally of the late cartel founder El Mencho (Nemesio Oseguera Cervantes, killed February 22, 2026). The arrest — part of the Sheinbaum government's intensified security offensive in the CJNG succession period — dealt a significant blow to the faction of CJNG's fractured command structure loyal to El Mencho's historical inner circle. The capture followed the March 2026 confirmation that Juan Carlos Valencia González (El Mencho's stepson) was consolidating control as the new CJNG leader, with four rival factions competing for territorial dominance across Jalisco, Michoacán, Colima, and Nayarit. Flores Silva is accused of coordinating cartel operations in several Jalisco municipalities and facilitating arms trafficking and extortion networks. The operation demonstrated continued SEDENA intelligence capacity against CJNG despite the turbulence of the post-Mencho transition. Mexico's World Cup security planning — now 44 days from the June 11 opening — treats CJNG succession instability as a primary threat vector for Guadalajara and its surroundings.
